headline: SAFF holds 4.32 on Female Daily (flat vs yesterday and 7 days ago), still 0.05 ahead of Mykonos. New watch item: a 'saffnco.batam' Instagram account of unclear official status.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily today: SAFF 4.32 (1,747 reviews) and Alchemist 4.43 (569) unchanged vs 23 Nov and 17 Nov; no SAFF product score moved. HMNS, Mykonos and Onix pages could not be read today (last: 4.20, 4.27, 4.17).
S.O.T.B (4.1, 586 reviews) still makes up a third of SAFF's Female Daily reviews, so it sets the brand score more than any other scent.
Editorial reach continues: IDN Times put SAFF Morfosia in its 14 Nov rainy-season picks and Coco in its citrus picks, each next to HMNS and Mykonos.
SAFF official-store ratings stay very high: Irai Leima 4.9 from 5,124 Tokopedia ratings (about 0.5% at 1–2 stars) and Las Pozas 4.9 from 1,424 Zalora reviews.
Unofficial channels keep growing: a 'saffnco.batam' Instagram account and multi-brand Tokopedia shops (Irai Leima 35ml at Rp259,000) sell or use the SAFF name.

recommendations.text: Confirm whether the 'saffnco.batam' Instagram account is an official partner; if not, report it and pin a list of official accounts on the main profile.
Restock Cascavel on the official Tokopedia store, or add a back-in-stock notice, so buyers do not move to unofficial sellers.
Use product-level proof such as Irai Leima 4.9 from 5,124 Tokopedia ratings in ads and product pages, not store-wide scores.
For S.O.T.B, add 'how much to spray' and 'best for evening / cool rooms' guidance in copy to answer 'too strong' and 'common' complaints.
Run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder so low-star themes can be tracked.
